results.title: Pack and Ship | Eau Claire, WI | 54701 | Pak Mail
results.content: and took it to their place of business to securely pack it in a box surrounded by Styrofoam sheets and then placed into a wooden crate that was specifically built for the clock.  I was totally pleased with the care that was provided by Chris & his crew at Pak Mail in the shipping preparation of my clock for the journey from WI to WA.  It arrived in WA in great condition and the clock is now in my dining room chiming on the quarter hours and striking on the hour.  I had several other boxes of dishes and other item shipped by Pak Mail and everything arrived intact; nothing broken or damaged. I would totally recommend Chris and Pak Mail for all of your shipping needs.
